AI agents MUST NOT be listed as authors or co-authors of git commits.
Do NOT use `Co-authored-by:` trailers for AI agents
Do NOT add AI agents to commit author fields
The human developer who reviews and commits the code is the sole author
This is a FINOS-wide policy that applies to all projects under the FINOS umbrella.

Scala 3.7.4; Mill 1.1.x; ZIO; ScalaJS; experimental Scala Native. Main paths: `build.mill`, `mill-build/src/`, `morphir/` (shared `src/`, `jvm/src/`, `js/src/`, `contrib/`, `interop/`, `runtime/`, `testing/`, `tools/`), `.config/mise/`, `project/`.

Use mise:
`mise run setup`
`mise run lint`
`mise run fmt`
`mise run test:jvm`
`mise run test:js`
`mise run ci:local`

Or Mill:
`./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.compile`
`./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.test`
`./mill mill.scalalib.scalafmt.ScalafmtModule/reformatAll 'morphir.__.sources'`

Cross-platform module layout: `src/`, `jvm/src/`, `js/src/`, `src-3/`, `jvm/src-3.7/`. Scalafmt 3.10.4, Scala 3 dialect, max 120 columns. Run `mise run fmt` before committing. Use `given`/`using`, `enum`, `derives`, `extension`, `*` imports, `mvn""` (not deprecated `ivy""`), ZIO libraries, ZIO Test, `ZIOSpecDefault`; tests belong in `test/src/`. Run tests with `mise run test:jvm` or `./mill morphir[3.7.4].__.jvm.test`.

For modules: define in `build.mill`; create layout directories; update `platformSpecificModuleDeps` and parent dependencies. Check Scala 3.7.4, source placement, deprecated Mill 1.x syntax; run `mise run lint`. Use `./mill --no-server -j 1`; `./mill resolve __`; `./mill show <target>.sources`.

CI: lint, test-jvm (Java 21, 25), test-js, publish (Sonatype main/tags). Successful implementation requires a fully green build and resolution of all review comments.
Use `gh pr checks <pr-number> --watch --interval 30`.
If a check fails, investigate immediately. Do not mark task as done.
Use `gh pr view <pr-number> --json comments,reviews`.
Resolve all comments. Verify fixes locally before pushing. Only when CI is green and comments are zero/resolved is the feature complete.
